info.title: SignageWall API
info.description: Digital signage CMS API. Success responses use `{ success: true, data }`. Errors use `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }`.

acquisitionToken.description: Anonymous marketing attribution only; never used for authorization.

acceptedLegal.description: Must be true — the user accepts the current Terms of Service + Privacy Policy.

docTypes.description:
Which documents to accept at their current version. Omit to accept every
document that currently needs (re-)consent.

isSponsored.description: Covered by another account’s enterprise organization — hide plan prompts

requestedScreens.description: Total screens wanted, not the delta. Capped to keep typos out of the queue.

externalId.description: Provider-native id, echoed from the request.

error.description: Stable failure code when status is "failed" (e.g. forbidden_host, download_failed, invalid_file_type, file_too_large, import_failed).

externalId.description: Provider-native id; echoed back in the result.

mimeType.description: Client-declared MIME type. Validated per-item server-side against the allowed types (image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, video/mp4, video/webm, video/quicktime) and re-verified against the downloaded bytes.

authToken.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization on the URL GET (e.g. Google Photos). Used immediately server-side; never persisted.

endpoint.description: Microsoft Graph endpoint base for the item (msgraph strategy).

accessToken.description: Short-lived OAuth access token (Drive/Graph strategies). Used immediately server-side; never persisted.

type.description:
Item kind. Optional for back-compat with clients that only ever sent media
items (no `type`); the service defaults a missing value to `media`.

expectedUpdatedAt.description:
The `updatedAt` the client last observed. When provided, the write is
rejected with 409 if the playlist changed in the meantime (lost-update
protection for concurrent editors).

config.description: Draft app config to fetch preview data for.

slug.description: Slug of an available code manifest.

isPublic.description: Whether the app is offered to organizations.

appId.description: Catalog app id to create an instance of.

config.description: Instance config; validated against the app config schema.

expectedUpdatedAt.description:
The `updatedAt` the client last observed. When provided, the write is
rejected with 409 if the screen changed in the meantime (lost-update
protection for concurrent editors).

screenLimit.description: Licences sold. 0 is allowed: it freezes an account without deleting it.

paymentReference.description: Bank transfer or other reconciliation reference.

website.description: Honeypot. A populated value is acknowledged but never persisted.

input.description: The multi-step form inputs the user entered.

result.description: Validated generated content; present once the job succeeds.

playlistId.description: Id of the draft playlist created from this generation.
Id of the created draft playlist.

name.description: Name for the created playlist. Defaults to the model's suggested name.

playingItemId.description: Id of the renderable currently on screen

revision.description: Content revision the device is currently on

lastError.description: Most recent client-side error, if any

code.description: Pairing code shown on the display

orientation.description: Screen orientation applied by the player.

scale.description: How content is fitted to the screen.

enabled.description: Whether the automatic daily reload is enabled.

time.description: Time of day (24h 'HH:mm') in the device's local timezone.

direction.description: Step the player to the next or previous content item.

expiresAt.description: Optional auto-hide timestamp. Omit for a notification that never expires.

currentStep.description: First unfinished step; null once everything is done

showCelebration.description: Finished, but the user has not been shown that yet

dismissed.description: `true` closes the checklist for good; `false` brings it back.

completionAcknowledged.description: The user has seen the completion state — stop showing the checklist.
